faults.where: spec.waves (all three): modes call/copy/classify with items [30,45,60,90], [90,120,135,150], [40,90,110,180,270]
faults.detail: The targeted mix-up is 'Thinks the letters of an angle can be written in any order, so the vertex need not be the middle letter'. No round names an angle with letters, shows points A/B/C, or asks which letter is the vertex. The rounds only turn a beam to a degree value or sort by size, so a child holding the vertex-naming belief would never meet it here. 'Naam ka mod' / 'Har kona apna naam dhoondta hai' means type names (acute/right/obtuse/reflex), not vertex-letter names.

faults.where: spec.strings.hits = "milaans"; screen top pill "MILAANS 0/4" (p412 and l1366)
faults.detail: 'milaans' is not a word: it puts the English plural -s on the Hindi 'milaan'. A child would read it as a misspelling.

notes: Wave 3 ('classify', kind 'right', range 360) includes 180, which is a straight angle and fits none of the string labels acute/right/obtuse/reflex. The packet does not show how the engine grades 180 in this mode, so it is not counted.
